profiles.title: Cyberpunk 2077
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: Tested with DLSS-NR-on-AMD on DX12. Select DLSS, FSR, or XeSS in-game. Use Fast or Superfast mode on RX 6600 (Reference unavailable on RDNA 2).
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler v0.9.5 supports FSR 4.1.2 INT8 (FSR4-i8-2), FSR 3.1.2, and XeSS 2.0.2 via DX12.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: Use native FSR Frame Generation or OptiFG/Nukem dlssg-to-fsr3. Disable V-Sync when using DLSS-FG inputs; DLSS-FG is unsupported on RX 6600.
profiles.rayReconstructionNotes: Requires RDNA 3/4 for DLSS-RR Model F; unsupported on RX 6600.
knownProblems: High VRAM ray tracing presets can exceed 8GB VRAM on RX 6600 at 1080p; keep RT off or low for headroom.

profiles.title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: Ensure DX12 binary (bin\x64_dx12\witcher3.exe) is selected. Enable FSR2/XeSS/DLSS in graphics menu.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler upgrades native FSR 2 / DLSS inputs cleanly to FSR 4.1.2 INT8 or FSR 3.1.2.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: Nukem dlssg-to-fsr3 or OptiFG DX12 works on RX 6600 when native DLSS-FG is spoofed.
knownProblems: DX11 executable (bin\x64\witcher3.exe) does not support DX12 Neural Rendering or OptiFG.

profiles.title: Red Dead Redemption 2
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: Switch Graphics API from Vulkan to DirectX 12 in Settings and enable FSR 2 or DLSS.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler replaces native FSR 2.2 / DLSS with FSR 4.1.2 INT8 or FSR 3.1.2.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: Use OptiFG (DX12) with HUDfix enabled or AFMF 2 in Exclusive Fullscreen.
profiles.rayReconstructionNotes: Game has no native ray tracing / DLSS-RR inputs.
knownProblems: Vulkan API mode does not support DLSS-NR-on-AMD yet.

profiles.title: Shadow of the Tomb Raider
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: Run in DX12 mode and enable XeSS or DLSS input.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler converts XeSS/DLSS inputs to FSR 4.1.2 INT8 or FSR 3.1.2.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: OptiFG DX12 supported with HUDfix enabled.
profiles.rayReconstructionNotes: Unsupported on RDNA 2 and game lacks DLSS-D inputs.

profiles.title: FINAL FANTASY XVI
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: Disable Dynamic Resolution Scaling in game settings for stable NR temporal history.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: Native FSR 3.1 & DLSS inputs can be routed through OptiScaler v0.9.5 to FSR 4.1.2 INT8.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: Supports native FSR 3.1 Frame Generation; keep OptiFG OFF to prevent double frame generation.
knownProblems: 8GB VRAM budget on RX 6600 requires Medium/High texture pool rather than Ultra.

profiles.title: Monster Hunter Wilds
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: RE Engine DX12 game; ensure Adrenalin 26.1.1+ and HIP 7.2.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler v0.9.5 supports FSR 4.1.2 INT8 and XeSS replacement.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: Native FSR 3.1 FG supported; prevent double FG.
knownProblems: RE Engine titles may require REFramework (dinput8.dll) if game enforces integrity checks on proxy loads.

profiles.title: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: OFFLINE STORY MODE ONLY. Requires BattlEye disabled via -nobattleye or Rockstar Launcher setting.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: Native FSR / DLSS / XeSS inputs supported in Story Mode.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: FSR-FG / OptiFG only in offline Story Mode.
knownProblems: CRITICAL: Never connect to GTA Online with any rendering mod DLLs installed; BattlEye must be disabled (-nobattleye).

profiles.title: Dragon's Dogma 2
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: DLSS-NR-on-AMD v0.9.0 fixes RE Engine device hangs with upscaler inputs.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler v0.9.5 FSR 4.1.2 INT8 / FSR 3.1.2 supported.
profiles.frameGenerationNotes: OptiFG DX12 or native FSR 3 FG supported.
knownProblems: CPU-heavy urban areas limit frame pacing; keep FG frame-ahead at 1.

profiles.title: STAR WARS Jedi: Survivor
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: DLSS-NR-on-AMD v0.9.0 fixed start crash with GPU spoof.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler v0.9.5 includes Manual Input Polling quirk so overlay mouse input works properly.

profiles.title: Resident Evil Requiem
profiles.neuralRenderingNotes: RE Engine DX12 title; v0.9.0 fixes device hang on RE9.
profiles.superResolutionNotes: OptiScaler v0.9.5 FSR 4.1.2 INT8 / FSR 3.1.2 supported.
knownProblems: Requires REFramework (dinput8.dll) if native integrity checks block unsigned hooks.
